caption: The drawing shows three main objects on a plain, light beige background. On the left, there is an L-shaped wooden staff or pole with a natural wood texture, brown in color, and a lighter beige tip at the lower end; it also features a black section bound with what appears to be metallic or golden bands. In the middle and to the right, there is a long, straight pole attached to a large, green fabric item that appears to be a flag or banner. The fabric is draped and has a darker green fringe along the edge, with a golden, decorative finial at the tip of the pole. To the far right of the drawing, there is a close-up depiction of the golden finial with the green fabric attached. The composition of the image is carefully arranged with the three objects spaced apart, all meticulously rendered in detail using soft and naturalistic colors.
title: Parasol
